description.narrative: This project aims to achieve improved access to education and healthcare services for women, girls and other groups at risk of discrimination, by targetting 3 outcomes:• public institutions take measures to close corruption loopholes and address vulnerabilities in the education and health sectors;• women, girls and groups at risk of discrimination become increasingly aware of their rights, and engaged to demand accountability from duty-bearers delivering education and health services; • national, regional and international stakeholders increasingly recognise the need to mainstream anti-corruption in service delivery in these areas. Value of the contract is EUR 5,953,121.2

participating-org.narrative: Canada - Global Affairs Canada | Affaires mondiales Canada

activity-date.narrative: Planned end date has changed from March to December 2026

recipient-region.narrative: The countries involved are: Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Ghana, Madagascar, Rwanda, Zimbabwe, Canada, GTNI Health (TI UK).
